name: @restregular/dsh-notepad
description: Notepad — a per-workspace floating notepad in the DeepSeek Harness session view with a dedicated settings tab (themes that also color the settings page, flat / frosted-glass surfaces, fonts, save mode, AI prompt presets with a read-only preset preview, button groups, hover delay, card height and captured geometry defaults), plugin undo / redo that never overrides textarea history and never drops typed text, collapsible segments with batch select / archive / delete / copy, an AI improve that switches to the selected text and re-selects it after rewriting, newest-first archives with auto-scroll, a right-aligned non-wrapping action bar whose overflow slides under the left selection label, a workspace dropdown limited to workspaces with an unarchived non-empty segment, oldest-first segment cards with click-to-edit titles, Enter split, Backspace merge (including the same exit animation for empty-card deletion), drag reorder, arrow-key navigation, delayed hover action groups that collapse after mouse activation and use distinct new-session insert / send icons, in-panel image previews, rotating shortcut tips, busy-send policy, image cleanup, pending badges, scroll-safe auto refresh and dark-mode styling. · 记事本 — 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面显示一个按工作区共享的分段便签浮窗，并新增「记事本」设置页：配色主题（同步作用于设置页）、纯色扁平 / 可调模糊的毛玻璃、字体字号、自动 / 手动保存、撤销步数、按钮组与 hover 阈值、AI 提示词预设（只读展示预设内容）、分段最大高度、可把当前面板位置尺寸存为默认。插件提供撤销 / 重做（输入框仍用原生撤销，输入文字也会进入插件历史而不会丢失），分段可折叠，支持批量选择、归档、删除与复制；选中文字时 AI 只优化选中部分并在完成后重新选中；归档按最新在上并自动滚动；顶部工作区下拉只列出存在未归档且非空分段的工作区，点击切换到该工作区的新会话；工具栏为右对齐、不换行的单行按钮区，溢出时隐藏到左侧文本下方，批量操作时「取消选择」位于最左侧；Backspace 删除空分段也有退出动画；批量删除悬停变红；插入 / 发送的新会话图标相互区分；图片不显示名称，删除按钮位于缩略图右上角；分段进出都有过渡动画，自动保存不再把列表滚回顶部；AI 优化提高短内容输出预算并在空正文时自动重试。
author: RestRegular
